notes.title: BigUpdate Demo 0.2.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a multi-layer map mechanism, and the map becomes more difficult layer by layer
[*]   - -After defeating the boss, you can choose to enter the next layer until you complete the final challenge
[*]   - -After entering the next layer of the room, the health of all nodes is restored
[*] Reconstructed the room and enemy mechanism and optimized the values, smoothed the difficulty curve, and was more friendly to novices
[*] Added a bottom-line mechanism, players can get free weapons outside the game
[*] Optimized key settings
[*]   - -Both Shift and space keys can be used for sprinting
[*]   - - Changed the default movement method to hold down WASD
[*] Insure the adventure outside the game, changing the weight ratio to the number of nodes
[*] UI optimization:
[*]   - -The snake body bar shows unfilled columns
[*]   - -Optimized the card UI size and button layout
[*] Fixed some bugs
[*]Next update preview:
[*]   - -Optimized the warehouse system: optimize the operation method, add filtering functions, and expand the tabs
[*]   - -Added a "Boss Rush" map
[*]   - -Added a room mechanism change system
[/list]

notes.title: BugFix25031101
notes.content:
[h2]Demo update 25031101:[/h2]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
  - Enemies did not disappear correctly after death
  - Walk diagonally after escaping the hovering state
  - Diamonds are accumulated extra per game
  - Accessories can be added after reaching the upper limit
  - Node selling prices are displayed incorrectly
[h3]Performance optimization:[/h3]
  - Various explosion effects
